summary: Retest of the iteration_1 readiness/contention bug: FIXED. With the API, two acquires on the same lock give window5m acquired=1/denied=1, contentionRate 0.5, burnRate 0, lockAvailability 1.0, burnLevel healthy. Readiness then fails only 'Lock contention < 1%' (NO-GO). POST /api/console/metrics/reset-window clears the samples (samplesCleared>=2, audited SLO_WINDOW_RESET) and readiness returns to GO. In the UI, the Locks split-brain race (1 WIN) makes Metrics show contention 66.67%, burn 0.00x, availability 100%, and LockContentionRateHigh firing; Readiness shows NO-GO. Clicking reset-slo-window-button shows the 'SLO window reset (audited)' toast and slo-window-info shows 0/0, after which Readiness is GO 17/17. Revoke guard: revoking the active key returns 409 INVALID_STATE (API and UI toast with requestId), revoke is blocked in safe mode with 403 SAFE_MODE, and revoking a non-active key works. Regression: test_frasberg_api.py (18 tests incl. 3 new) all pass with -n0; the built-in runner gives 72/72.

minor.issue: Outbox success rate still uses lifetime counters (35.29% after the fail/dead-letter tests) and has no window or reset. It is not a readiness check, so it is not blocking, but the same class of issue as the lock SLO.
Not guarded by safe mode (likely fine, since it is an operator recovery action).

issues: Revoke button is still shown on the ACTIVE key and only gives an error toast when clicked. Hide or disable it for status=active.
The 'New key' field defaults to validator-key-002, which is revoked.

action_items: Optional: hide or disable the Revoke button for the active key on the Keys page
Optional: window the outbox success rate as well, or include it in reset-window
critical_code_review_comments: acquire_lock: DuplicateKeyError -> denied sample (excluded from availability) and other exceptions -> error sample. Logic is correct. lock_samples has a 2h TTL index, which covers the 1h window.
The self-test runner uses Store(prefix='selftest_'), so its lock samples do not pollute the live window (confirmed: readiness GO after the 72/72 run plus reset)
